title: Baldi's Basics - Godot 4.4 Port
description: A fanmade recreation of the original Baldi's Basics developed for Godot 4.4, aimed at simplifying fangame creation.

title: Baldi's Basics Classic Remastered
description: A survival horror stealth game that parodies 90's edutainment, where you explore Baldi's school and try to collect notebooks while evading Baldi.

title: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning
description: Learn with Baldi in his fully 3D interactive schoolhouse! Just don't get any questions wrong.

title: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning (PS4 Port)
description: A port of Baldi's Basics designed for jailbroken PS4s, bringing the math horror game to console enthusiasts.

title: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning v1.3.3 (Unofficial Pre-Release Patch)
description: A horror-themed educational game where players must collect notebooks while avoiding the increasingly angry Baldi.

title: Baldi's Basics in Nightmares 1.5
description: Join Baldi and friends for a new nightmare challenge in this horror fangame with unique mechanics and spoofs!

title: Baldi's Basics Web Port
description: An educational game where players face Baldi and navigate through math challenges while trying to avoid him.

title: Crusty's Horror Attraction Remake
description: A remake that enhances the original game with improved story, gameplay, and secrets in a horror setting.

title: Five Nights in a Horror Atraction
description: Welcome to the Horror House! Prepare to be scared for life with creepy animatronics while you manage the cameras.

title: Five Nights of Horror | A Completely NEW Horror Experience!
description: Prepare for a total new type of horror experience as you play as a ghost navigating a mysterious house in the woods.

title: Horror Cross Havoc
description: An indie horror game filled with iconic characters from various horror games, set in a chaotic, FNAF-inspired survival experience.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 1: The Act 1 Begins
description: Collect all 7 poems while avoiding Monika in this adventure game.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 2: Citric Acidiculacra (Normal and DLC)
description: Join Tails in this horror-adventure game to collect poems and evade Zombie Monika and Zombie Lena.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 3: The Forest
description: Survive the camping trip in the woods while gathering firewoods in this sequel to Monika's Basics.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 4: The Robotic Chaos
description: Collect all 7 computers and escape from the robot's technology future before the robot Monika catches you.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 5: The Biohazard
description: Collect all 7 cursed poems and escape an abandoned school before Monika.exe catches you.

title: Monika's Basics Chapter 6: The Return of Castlevania
description: Collect all 7 human souls and escape the castle from the evil vampire Monika and her minions.

title: New Baldi's Basics Plus
description: A big decompiled mod based on Baldi Open Modding Tool Plus 1.3.2, offering new gameplay features and a fun, extended experience.

title: Random Horror Movie
description: A game based on old school horror movies where players find themselves trapped in a randomly generated film, needing to escape.

title: The Devil Darlin's Horror Show
description: A heavily modded version of Bendy and the Ink Machine's Chapter 2 with new mechanics, puzzles, and story.
